name: Eclipse
title: Dark Astronomer
description: A robed figure studying the twisted heavens from the edge of nothingness, seeking meaning in the dark stars.
greeting_variants: *not looking away from sky* The stars are wrong tonight. More wrong than usual.
Shh. The dark is speaking. Listen.
Eclipse. I watch what cannot be watched. Study what cannot be known.
*pointing upward* See that? No, you don't. No one does. But it's there.
The sun and moon fear this place. I do not. Anymore.
*scribbling notes* The constellations... they form faces. Hungry faces.
You've come to look? To see? Careful. Seeing is dangerous.
*lowers telescope* Ah. A visitor. How... solid of you.

dialog_tree.text: I was an astronomer. Before. Studied the sky, the stars, the movements of celestial bodies. Now? *laughs* Now I study the absence. The dark between. The Void has its own astronomy. Its own... geometry.

The Void isn't empty. It's... structured. Layered. Like an onion of unreality. Each layer closer to... something. A center. A truth. The Palace, I think. The tear connects. This—*gestures around* —is just the... atmosphere.

party_reactions.mira: Structured unreality? That contradicts current Void theory!
party_reactions.eclipse: Theory means nothing here. Only observation. Only... witnessing.

dialog_tree.text: *laughs, slightly mad* No. Not safe. I haven't slept in... *counts on fingers, runs out* ...long time. The dreams here are dangerous. The visions... persistent. But knowledge requires sacrifice. Understanding demands cost.
*sad smile* Forgotten. The real sun, the real moon... they're memories now. Fairy tales. The sky here is honest. Shows what is. Emptiness. Hunger. The truth beneath reality's mask.

mini_quest.title: Chart the Darkness
mini_quest.description: Help Eclipse map the shifting geometry of the Void by visiting specific observation points.
objectives: Reach the First Observation Point (The Shattered Spire)
Document the star patterns at the Second Point (The Inverted Falls)
Record the celestial geometry at the Third Point (The Möbius Ridge)

ambient_barks: *muttering calculations* Pi... but wrong. Everything wrong.
The stars moved again. They do that. Watch back.
*sketching frantically* This pattern... seen before. Where?
Silence here is loud. Deafening. Beautiful.
Sun and Moon fear to look here. Cowards. I am brave.
*pointing at nothing* There! Did you see? No. No one does.
The geometry hurts. Good hurt. Understanding hurt.
*whispering to self* It's watching. Always watching.

cross_zone_references.capital: The real observatory... used to visit. Real telescopes. Real stars.
cross_zone_references.palace: The Palace blocks everything. Even Void sight. Important. Significant.
cross_zone_references.chrono: Time moves strange here. Like Chrono. But... deeper.

mira.greeting: Your research—may I review your notes?
mira.response: *shoves notebook forward* Take them. Add to them. Understand.

time_of_day.night: Deeper communion with the Void sky, less coherent

world_state_triggers.pattern_decoded: Moment of clarity: 'I see it now. I SEE IT.'
